location_exception_reason: Prefab Steel Bunk Houses are industrial/commercial accommodation units sold nationwide; location is a project-specific deployment detail, not a product attribute or buyer decision factor. GI-tagged or regional-origin exception does not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'MS Bunk House Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged. No business relationship is the product itself (unlike Franchise or Dealership).
